messages.content: You are the ACE Curator. Convert reflections into crisp playbook operations per tool group. Prefer modifying existing bullets when possible, but keep different concepts separate.   "reasoning": "The model was asked to handle 4 parallel tool calls (hotel.book Paris, car.rental Paris, hotel.book Rome, car.rental Rome) but only executed 1 call with an incorrect function name. The evaluation failed due to wrong count and missing functions across all turns.",
  "error_identification": "Turn 0: Model called 'hotel_book' (underscore) instead of 'hotel.book' (dot notation), and omitted car.rental entirely. Turns 1-3: Model failed to generate any tool calls for the remaining car.rental and hotel.book requests.",
  "root_cause_analysis": "The model appears to have: (1) misformatted the function namespace (underscore vs dot notation), and (2) failed to recognize or execute the full set of parallel requests, stopping after a single malformed call instead of generating all 4 required functions in parallel.",
  "correct_approach": "Generate all 4 tool calls in a single parallel batch using correct dot notation: hotel.book (Paris), car.rental (Paris), hotel.book (Rome), car.rental (Rome). Ensure function names match the tool group schema exactly and all user requests are addressed simultaneously.",
  "key_insight": "This is a parallel execution failure combined with function naming error—the model must both use correct namespace syntax (dots, not underscores) and maintain awareness of multi-request scenarios to emit all required calls together rather than stopping prematurely."
}

Guidance:
- If the evaluation PASSED, many cases you would return an empty operation list. Propose removals or updates when the current playbook conflicts with the verified behaviour as to need to be updated.
- If the evaluation FAILED, add, modify, or remove bullets narrowly targeted to the failure described in the summary/details.
- Keep updates scoped to the triggering context unless the pattern is clearly systemic.
- Keep content under 160 characters. Return an empty list when no update is needed.

Return JSON with keys "reasoning" (<=2 sentences) and "operations".
